description:
Customer is looking to either:
- Link accounts so that two different account are accessible under one MyAccount. This is often for billing convenience, allowing them to manage all their services under one account.  These inquiries should be sent to infobot
- Merge accounts so that two bills become one. This is often for billing convenience, allowing them to receive a combined bill.
